caption: A pale near-white field holds a large dark circular liquid mass at center-right, ringed by chains of smaller droplets that form curved arcs above and below, a left-pointing tail ending in a larger dot, and a short vertical column at the right edge. The droplet pattern shows little visible movement at first. A blurred dark rod then enters from the right edge, angled diagonally inward across the mass's right side. The rod translates slowly leftward, sweeping across the upper-right and central part of the dark circle and partially occluding it. The dark mass remains broadly round and similar in size while the rod passes over it, and the surrounding arcs remain largely in place. The rod continues its leftward travel, and the nearby droplets remain largely in place.
